hero.roleLine: Human-centered AI researcher and research engineer
hero.lede: I study how people judge generative AI: what they trust, what they miss, and what happens when those judgments must support an audit or workplace decision. I also build the interfaces and data infrastructure needed to study those interactions.
hero.context: PhD candidate in Computer Science at The George Washington University.

researchApproach: My dissertation follows human judgment across five settings: perceptions of trust, fairness, and risk; lay-user auditing; reflection on interaction histories; workplace adoption and governance; and professional evaluation practice.

Across these studies, I examine the difference between noticing a concern, turning it into evidence another person can use, and acting on it. I also build the open-source interfaces and data infrastructure needed to collect that evidence.

jobSearch.text: I'm looking for research and research-engineering roles in human-centered AI evaluation, AI safety, responsible AI, and privacy. My work combines empirical research with the systems needed to run it.

projectsPage.lede: Selected research on how people evaluate generative AI, how AI use is governed in practice, and the tools needed to collect human judgment as usable evidence.

publicationsPage.lede: Peer-reviewed work on how people judge AI systems, how researchers should measure those judgments, and how privacy information is produced, maintained, and communicated.

cvPage.lede: Education, publications, research experience, and the systems behind them, in one PDF.
cvPage.summary: PhD candidate in Computer Science (usable security and privacy; trustworthy AI) at The George Washington University, advised by Adam Aviv. Recent work spans chatbot auditing studies, privacy-label measurement, and the software that runs them.

researchProfile.label: Research
researchProfile.value: Human-centered evaluation, AI auditing, trust, privacy, and governance of generative AI.

researchProfile.label: Methods
researchProfile.value: Interactive experiments, large-scale online studies, interviews, surveys, qualitative analysis, and mixed methods.

researchProfile.label: Systems
researchProfile.value: Evaluation interfaces, auditing workflows, AI interaction-history dashboards, study platforms, and human-data infrastructure.
